Rick Carlisle's Pacers come home on Indy 500 Day looking to pull away from the Knicks after grinding out wins in the first two games in New York City. Ninth-year forward Pascal Siakam exploded for 39 points in Game 2, while Jalen Brunson's 39.5 ppg and eight assists/game have not been enough for the Knicks, who now look to build on their 5-1 road record this postseason.
